limitations: Design only; no runtime tests executed.
Rows/actors/returns are not test or PASS counts.
REMOTE extra unissued ticket is a negative domain control, not integrated CLIENT authority.
Mutated manifest/key requests are serial negative controls without new review.
Only same approved M/target CREATE competition; other packages/targets/modes remain outside.
Probe observes exclusion, not entry into blocking flock.
Historical controls retain their original scope and absent raw/context limits.
No integrated persistence/recovery or global criterion closure from isolated PASS.
Git tracking is local; remote not freshly queried.
